title: DepKeeper - Python Dependency Updater
description: A CLI that updates requirements.txt without crossing a major version. It works out a safe target for each package, checks them against each other, then rewrites the file in place and keeps the upper bounds and exclusions you wrote. Every change shows as a dry run first, and running it twice changes nothing the second time. On PyPI under Apache 2.0, for Python 3.8 to 3.12.

title: Now Boarding Scheduler - Board Game Session Planner
description: A weekly session scheduler for a board game cafe in Bengaluru. It takes four poll CSVs (game preferences, availability, which venue people can reach) and returns a timetable where nobody is double-booked and no physical copy of a game runs twice in the same slot. Under the hood it is a mixed-integer program solved to a proven optimum with SciPy's HiGHS, in six priority passes where a later pass can't undo an earlier one. Every scheduled session comes with a plain-English reason it was picked.
